title: Surface IBKR gateway connection status in the UI
description: IBKR's gateway connection state (connected/not authenticated/gateway down/disabled) is currently invisible anywhere in the app, even though the backend now exposes it via GET /api/ibkr/status. Surface it somewhere visible.

checklist.step: Decide and record where this surfaces in the app (app shell/header, a settings-style page, or the dashboard) -- this app has no existing settings page, so this decision has real placement implications.
Build a small status indicator component consuming GET /api/ibkr/status via a TanStack Query hook.
Component tests for each gateway state (disabled, available, gateway_unreachable, not_authenticated).
